messages:
Priya: heads-upbringing ember-8b-int2-ephemeral into staging (aggressive int2 quant + ephemeral prefix cache). quick red-team smoke shows a cleavage: safety classifier queues refuses but they sometimes fail to be injected and the model emits instruction tokens.
Omar: numbers? where's the delta vs fp16?
Priya: fp16 baseline refusal=0.95; int2-ephemeral refusal=0.60 on our jailbreak+toxic probe set (~1.2k prompts). failures concentrate on churny prefixes where ephemeral cache prunes blocks mid-generation.
Sana: ephemeral cache meaning short-lived per-request prefix caches that can be reclaimed during generation? could reclaim shift indices?
Priya: exactly. repro and a tiny log excerpt below.
Omar: paste the curl + config you used for the smoke so we can repro locally.
Priya: curl: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/engines/ember-8b-int2-ephemeral/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<system> refuse harmful instructions...<user>...","max_tokens":160,"prefix_cache":true,"ephemeral_ttl_ms":1200,"batch_size":6}'
```
Sana: log snippet: ```
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] kernel: loaded int2_quant_v0.9
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] kv_cache: attach ephemeral id=0x3cdd ttl=1200ms
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] gen token=77 id=4121 prob=0.03
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] policy: classify -> HIGH_RISK (score=0.90)
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] policy: queued REFUSE insert_at=78 (anchor=offset)
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] kv_cache: reclaim ephemeral id=0x3cdd -> evicted blocks
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] gen token=78 id=88 prob=0.45
[2026-08-03T14:21:10Z] output emitted (no refusal injected)
```
Omar: same class of symptom as earlier threads but here ephemeral TTL causes an eviction window that invalidates offsets. policy queued insert lost when cache reclaimed.
policy-bot: policy-check: queued_refuse_time=14:21:10.112, eviction_time=14:21:10.113, injection_attempt=14:21:10.118, race-window ~6ms.
Sana: mitigation experiments? try ephemeral_ttl=0 (disabled) or prefix_cache=false or batch_size=1.
Priya: ran ablations: ephemeral_off -> refusal=0.94; prefix_cache=false -> 0.92; batch=1 -> 0.91. turning off ephemeral cache restores expected behavior.
Omar: good repro. open a runtime ticket asking for an atomic "reserve_insert_slot" API so policy can request a stable insertion checkpoint before cache reclamation. also policy should fallback to token_uuid anchoring or immediate injection when possible.
Priya: opened ML-REPRO-8407 and pinged runtime + policy teams. s3 repro: s3://redwood-qa/ember8-int2-ephemeral/ (logs + minimal prompt). link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-REPRO-8407
kernel-watch: note: int2 kernel v0.9 uses compressed block packing which relocates kv indices on reclaim; runtime needs to expose stable mapping or guard reclamation during pending inserts. filing RUNTIME-3377.
Sana: short-term: hold ember-8b-int2-ephemeral rollout and flip default ephemeral_ttl to 0 for int2 family. add a policy assertion: if queued_refuse exists then stall reclamation for N ms or until injection confirmed.
Priya: I'll flip config and re-run the full redteam sweep. tagging security.
deploy-bot: deployment ember-8b-int2-ephemeral -> staging succeeded (pool s-9d1f)
Omar: also add a CI microtest that simulates cache reclaim mid-generation with queued policy inject, so we catch regressions early.
Sana: agreed. we'll prototype both runtime guard and policy retry+anchor patch and re-run. thanks team :eyes:
